title: Psychedelic 60s
content: Apply 1960s psychedelic aesthetic with mind-expanding visuals. Vibrant, clashing colors: electric orange, hot pink, acid green, purple, yellow. Swirling, flowing patterns. Op-art optical illusions. Paisley and mandala motifs. Melting, warping text effects. Kaleidoscope patterns. Peace symbols and flower power elements. Liquid, organic flowing shapes. Trippy, groovy, consciousness-expanding atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create trippy 1960s psychedelic style with swirling patterns, vibrant colors, and mind-bending effects.

variants.advanced: Apply 1960s psychedelic aesthetic with mind-expanding visual intensity. Color palette: vibrant, high-saturation, often clashing - electric orange (#ff6600), hot pink (#ff1493), acid green (#00ff00), purple (#9400d3), yellow (#ffff00), cyan. Colors can vibrate against each other. Swirling patterns: spiral shapes, concentric circles, flowing organic forms - implement using SVG paths with animation, or CSS radial/conic gradients with rotation. Op-art: optical illusion patterns (wavy lines, checkerboard warps, moiré effects) using repeating gradients. Paisley and mandala: intricate decorative patterns as backgrounds or accents (SVG). Typography: psychedelic display fonts (heavily stylized, Art Nouveau influenced), warped text using SVG textPath on curves, melting/dripping letter effects. Kaleidoscope: symmetrical radial patterns, often animated rotation. Flower power: stylized flowers, peace symbols, love motifs. Liquid shapes: blob forms morphing and flowing, use CSS border-radius animation or SVG. Background: often solid bright color or complex pattern, rarely plain. Poster aesthetic: inspired by concert posters (Fillmore, Avalon Ballroom). Interactive: colors shift, patterns rotate on hover/scroll. Animation: slow, flowing movements, morphing shapes. Sound visualization: represent music visually with reactive patterns. Implementation: SVG essential for complex patterns, CSS animations for movement. Accessibility: CRITICAL - busy patterns can cause seizures, respect prefers-reduced-motion, provide calm alternative, ensure text readable against wild backgrounds.
